name: alphaink-newsletter
description: AlphaInk Newsletter Suite — invio, automazioni, calendario e analytics newsletter con Brevo + Firebase

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace=@alphaink/web
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=@alphaink/web && npm run build --workspace=functions
scripts.build:web: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=@alphaink/web
scripts.build:functions: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=functions
scripts.deploy:functions: npm run build:functions && firebase deploy --only functions
